title: feat(plugin-detail)!: one record page laid out by its own width; 动态 is the right column's first panel
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgQSrPxYRF6Q9RRD48Snj7Ks)_
Part of #27524
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: content — `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` described the synthesized record page's tab strip, its column tiers, the related rail and the timeline column; it now describes the details and the right column, 动态 first, laid out by one rule. No file under `skills/**` teaches the record page's layout (a `git grep` for the tiers, the switch and the stream names nothing there).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：合成记录页只按容器宽度一条规则排版。≥ 760 px 详情 | 右栏 320 px；≥ 1120 px 右栏 380 px、详情字段 3 列、动态 5 条；< 760 px（分屏 720、手机）单列：详情，再按顺序接右栏各面板。三列档、页签档、「相关 N」导轨、常驻时间线列和它的 ⊞ 开关全部退役。动态（原时间线）成为右栏第一个面板：一行输入框、最新 3 条（宽档 5 条）、「查看全部 N 条」打开动态页签（`?related=timeline`，完整流：筛选、回复、加载更多）。右栏开关 ⊟（「右栏」，`⌘⇧,`）只剩一个图标。
- 为什么改：#27524 的 Target 4、5、6（画布 60 定稿），四个串行 PR 中的第二个；⊟ 移到顶栏在 PR ④，页签行在 PR ③。
- 风险与回滚：只动 ui 包（plugin-detail、components、app-shell、十个语言包）、文档和两个夜间 live 测试 spec。合成页的动态在每个宽度都开页即读（原先窄档要等页签）。`detail.timeline` 的值改成 动态 / Activity，所以手写页面的 `Timeline` 页签不再映射到它，仍读「时间线」。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordPageColumns.tsx`（档位与右栏）；`RecordTimelinePanel.tsx` + `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` 的 peek 面；`synth/recordPageColumns.ts`（宽度规则）；app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx`（⊟ 与开页读）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordTimelinePanel-27524.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052.test.tsx`，预期 3 个文件、23 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 单独改动 3571 行（+2052 / −1519，71 个文件），超过 3000 行人工合并线（AGENTS.md §7(c)），按 Tier H 落地：需要 os-zhuang 或 hotlong 的 APPROVED 审查，或你亲自合并。三成多是退役代码和按新结构改写的测试（验收第 4 条），第 5、6 条共用时间线列的退役，拆开反而要造一个只为删除而存在的过渡布局。
- 审查：契约审查 6523984004 在 `a38376b7be` 上判 FAIL。④-1：`⌘⇧,` 会串到抽屉下面的页面。④-2：在抽屉里按 Esc 会关掉整个抽屉，而不是先退出放大面。两个修复提交之后，复审 6525247890 判 PASS。预览审查两次 PASS（6524207275、6525118794）。遗留 #28156：抽屉最大化或在下层时，字段内的 Esc 会被抽屉接走；那段代码属 #27545。

## What changes

The synthesized record page is laid out by one rule, the width of the container it occupies, and 动态 becomes the right column's first panel (record page v4, canvas 60). This is PR ② of four serial PRs for #27524, approved by the seat as a split. It restarts from `main` after PR ① merged and leaves `main` coherent on its own.

| Target item | Where |
|---|---|
| 1, 2, 3, 10, 11, 12 | PR ① (merged) |
| 4 ⊟ the right-column switch | **this PR**, at the end of the record header's action row; PR ④ moves it to the top bar |
| 5 动态: a panel and a tab, never a column | **this PR** (the tab is the interim `?related=timeline` face; PR ③ makes it a tab of the tab row) |
| 6 tiers by the container's own width | **this PR** |
| 8, 9 the tab row, enlarged = active tab | PR ③ |
| 7 the top bar | PR ④, the one that closes the card |

**6. One rule** (`synth/recordPageColumns.ts`, `useRecordPageTier.ts`, `RecordPageColumns.tsx`). `recordPageTierFor(width)` answers `wide` from 1120 px (`RECORD_PAGE_WIDE_MIN_WIDTH`), `two-column` from 760 px, `stack` below it and for an unknown width. The embedded record (split pane, overlay drawer, maximized) and the phone take the same answer: `useRecordPageTier` lost `embedded`. Both column tiers draw details | the right column, 320 px (`grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_20rem]`) or 380 px when wide (`_23.75rem`). The stack is one column: the details, then the right column's panels in their order. A details section takes up to three field columns when wide and two beside a 320 px column (`DetailsColumnCapContext`, read by `framelessSectionColumns`). The three-column tier, the tabbed tier, the 「相关 N」 rail (`relatedRail`, `record-related-rail-toggle`), the resident timeline column, its ⊞ promotion and `recordTimelineDefaultReason` / `recordPageColumnDefaults` / `recordPageArrangementFor` retire. The right column is an `<aside aria-label="右栏">` in every tier.

**5. 动态 is a panel and a tab** (`RecordTimelinePanel.tsx`, `renderers/record-activity.tsx`, `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`). The panel leads the right column and has a related panel's header: 「动态」, the stream's count (`data-record-timeline-count`, absent while the feed loads), and the header row as one stretched button that opens the 动态 tab (the census rule from PR ①). Its body is the page's own `record:activity` block in a peek face, chosen by `RecordTimelinePanelContext`:
- a one-line composer (「写一条备注… @ 提到同事」, `detail.timelineComposer`). Pressed, it becomes the full composer, focused; a sent note folds it back;
- the newest 3 roots (5 when wide), one line each: icon, text, time. A reply is not a line of its own;
- 「查看全部 N 条 →」 when the stream holds more than it draws.

The 动态 tab is `?related=timeline`, the existing enlarged face: the whole stream with the 全部 · 活动 · 讨论 · 变更 chips, threaded replies and "Load more" (`data-stream-load-more`, one page per press; it replaces the stream's own 「查看全部」). The synthesized tab strip, where a page keeps one, orders details / 动态 / related for every object; the worked-object promotion is gone.

**4. ⊟** (app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx`, components `panel-toggles.tsx`). One toggle, 「右栏」, drawn at the end of the record header's action row only where the tier has a right column and the page has a panel for it. `⌘⇧,` flips it; `⌘⇧.` (the timeline column's) is gone. Off, the details take the row. The stored preference keeps its name, `record.columns.related`, so a reader's earlier related-column choice holds; `record.columns.timeline` is no longer read. `PanelToggles` draws icon-only toggles named by their label (no border group, `h-8 w-8`).

**Naming.** `detail.timeline` is 「动态」 / "Activity" in all ten packs (the values `detail.timelineFolded` had). `detail.relatedColumn` is 「右栏」 / "Right column"; `console.shortcuts.toggleRelated` follows. `detail.timelineFolded` and `console.shortcuts.toggleTimeline` leave every pack; `detail.timelineComposer` arrives in all ten.

**Tab labels** (components `containers.tsx`). With `detail.timeline` now naming the stream, the strip's well-known-token map could no longer send the bare word `Timeline` to it: the served approval page's history tab is labelled `Timeline`, and in en it read "Activity" (`approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPage` went red on exactly that). The synthesizer writes its own token, `Activity stream`, for its stream tab (read as `detail.timeline`), and an authored `Timeline` reads `console.objectView.viewTypeTimeline`, the pack's word for a timeline (zh-TW keeps its dict form). Pinned in `page-tabs-builtin-label-i18n-4645`.

**Open waves.** The 动态 panel is on screen at open in every tier, so a synthesized page reads its feed, the mention list and the audit log at open at every width (before, the narrow tier waited for the Timeline tab). Opening the 动态 tab reads none of them again. An authored page with tabs still waits for the tab that holds them (`recordOpenWaves-13010` keeps those cases unchanged).

**Review fixes.** The contract review 6523984004 on `a38376b7be` was FAIL, with must-fix ④-1 and should-fix ④-2. The delta review 6525247890 on `90828f16cb` is PASS.
- ④-1 (`d98543cb28`). A record page keeps its tree mounted under the drawer it opens. A drawer wide enough for its own right column draws its own ⊟, so one `⌘⇧,` ran both views' listeners. The page's listener ran first and flipped the hidden page's stored switch. Now only the topmost record root (the last `[data-record-page-root]` in the document) answers the chord.
- ④-2 (`d98543cb28`, `90828f16cb`). Inside the record pane, `Esc` on an open face (the 动态 tab, or a related list's whole face) closed or stepped the pane, because the face's guard found the pane's own dialog. The face now listens on the window in the capture phase and ignores the dialog that holds it. It takes the key ahead of the drawer's dialog layer and the split pane's listener.
  - An `Esc` pressed in a text field inside the face still reaches the field, which closes its mention list or cancels an inline edit. The face marks it handled, so the drawer does not dismiss on it. The preview re-check on `d98543cb28` found this case, and `90828f16cb` fixes it.
- Not fixed here, filed as #28156. When the pane is maximized or below the stack's root, its `onEscapeKeyDown` acts without reading `defaultPrevented`. So `Esc` in a field inside a face restores or steps the pane there. That handler is in `navigation-overlay.tsx`, #27545's surface, and the behaviour is on `main` today at level 2 and deeper.

**Declared.** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`. Two changesets:
- `27524-record-page-tiers-activity-panel.md` (plugin-detail, components, app-shell): eight exports and three members leave the plugin-detail entry, under `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` with one FROM → TO line each. The gate verifies all eleven. `RecordPageTier` becomes `'stack' | 'two-column' | 'wide'`, and `recordPageTierFor` takes one argument. Both are said in prose.
- `27524-record-page-activity-i18n.md` (i18n): `TranslationKeys` loses the two keys, under `not-required (runtime-interface-only …#TranslationKeys)`, as PR ① did.

**Size: over the human-merge threshold.** This PR changes 3,571 lines (+2,052 / −1,519 over 71 files, `additions + deletions`), over the 3,000 of AGENTS.md §7(c), so it lands the way a Tier H surface does: an authorized APPROVED review (GOVERNED_APPROVERS) and then the owning seat, or the maintainer's merge. It is not split further. More than a third of it is retired code and pins rewritten to the new anatomy (acceptance item 4), and Target 5 and 6 share one retirement, the timeline column: a split would have to build an interim layout that exists only to be deleted by the next PR.

**Source re-measured.** The card names `record.timeline.*` keys. No such namespace exists: the record page's labels are `detail.timeline` (value changed), `detail.timelineFolded` and `console.shortcuts.toggleTimeline` (both retired). The 1200 px board draws the details grid at three columns; this follows the card's rule, two columns beside the right column below 1120 px.

**File surface.** Outside the card's list: `components/src/custom/panel-toggles.tsx` (⊟ is icon-only), `components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (the `Timeline` token above), `app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts` (the timeline switch's preference retires), `RichTextCommentInput.tsx` (`autoFocus` for the expanded composer), `DetailSection.tsx` / `defaultRecordPage.ts` (the details column cap), the plugin-detail README, `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`, three items of `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` that located the stream by the retired column, and `ui/e2e/live/record-history-display.spec.ts` (opens `?related=timeline`; on `main` #28009 had re-pointed it at the folded Activity card that this PR retires).

Seat-approved addition (the dispatch keeps `examples/**` off limits): `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`, the Contoso case only. #28009 pinned it to the tabbed tier at a 780 px window, and Target 6 retires that tier, so the nightly showcase smoke would go red on this PR's merge. The case now reads the one-column stack tier instead (seat 2 widened the surface to this one file; the rest of `examples/**` is untouched).

## Tests

New:

- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordTimelinePanel-27524.test.tsx` (7): the real `record:activity` block in the panel. Header 「Activity」 and the whole stream's count, the header opens the tab; the newest three roots (a reply is not a line), no chips, no load-more, 「查看全部 8」 opens the tab; five when wide; no 「查看全部」 when the stream holds no more; no count while the feed loads; the one-line composer expands focused and folds after a sent note; CONTROL: outside the panel the same block is the full stream.

- `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.enlargedEscapeInPane-27524.test.tsx` (6). It runs through the real `NavigationOverlay` (its Radix sheet and its split listener), with the page's blocks stubbed:
  - in the drawer, `Esc` on the 动态 tab returns to the record's page, and the next `Esc` dismisses the drawer;
  - below the drawer's root, the face closes and the level stays;
  - in the split pane beside a list, the face closes and the pane stays;
  - an open menu owns `Esc`;
  - a text field in the face gets its `Esc` while the face and the pane stay, in the drawer and in the split pane.

Rewritten to the new anatomy, not deleted (acceptance item 4):

- `RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678` (6): 1440 and 1200 wide (380 px, details grid at three), 1100 two-column (320 px, two), 720 and 390 one column with 动态 after the details, embedded at 1440 and 720 by the same rule, `?tab=` addresses no strip and `?related=timeline` is the full stream.
- `RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052` (10): one icon 「Right column」 at the end of the action row; off and on; survives a remount, per object; non-worked and container objects open with the right column; `⌘⇧,` by key and by character, inert in a text field; `⌘⇧.` is not the page's; not drawn in the one column; drawn for the embedded record at 1440; with a 1000 px drawer over a 1440 px page, `⌘⇧,` flips the drawer's switch alone, and the page's once the drawer is gone.
- `recordPageV3Face-27055` (the details column cap: two beside a 320 px right column), `RecordPageColumns.test`, `RecordPageColumns.switches-27052`, `synth/recordPageColumns.test`, `synth/recordPageColumns.switches-27052`, `RelatedCardStack-27055`, `recordTimelineStream-27055`, `buildDefaultPageSchema.*` (order details / 动态 / related for every object), `panel-toggles.test`, `workspacePreference.*`.
- `examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`, the Contoso case (nightly showcase smoke): at 780 px (732 px of view) the page is `stack`, `data-record-columns-shown="details"`, no Details / Related tab; Invoices and Projects are body tables in the details with their rows read at open; the right column's first panel is 动态, Invoices and Projects are not panels; the Contacts panel reads 「Carl Fox」 once scrolled into view. The flat-details, money-strip and footer assertions are unchanged.
- The app-shell pins that opened the tabbed tier read the laid-out page: approvals (`approvalLock-12220`, `approvalLock-25934`, `approvalRecallGate`: the first of the page's probes), the feed and audit pins (`?related=timeline`), the related-list wire pins (`relatedBadgeArity-8882` and `relatedListFilter-4664` read the panel's count and rows; `relatedListInheritedSort-5795` and `childWriteRefreshesParent-12244` open the list's whole face), `relatedCountsFirst-27056`, `relatedListsOrder-27241`, `bodyTablePredicate-27478` (the right column), `accessibleNames-12625` (the right column and its panels are named), `recordOpenWaves-13010` (the synthesized cases read at open), and console `approvalRequestsDataSource.decisionPage` (the slotted request page is laid out; its actions list opens by `?related=`).

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots: on `examples/app-crm`, not HotCRM (deviation, as the order says); eleven shots `pr2-*.png` in `/mnt/project-files/ui-seat2/card-27524/shots/` (project files, not a repository branch), zh, through the console's dev server on `c888a82d32` (before the restart onto `main`; the record page code is unchanged by it). Measured in the page (container width → tier, right column width, 动态 lines):
  - `pr2-01-account-1440` (container 1184 → `wide`, right column 380, 动态 shows 5 of 6 and 「查看全部 6 条 →」), `pr2-02-account-1200` (944 → `two-column`, 320, 3 lines), `pr2-03-account-1000` (952 → `two-column`, 320).
